subject: soc-rt-dy
title: SOC.RT.DY.------TR.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 136 (ALT(FT)II-30). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism), RE-ST (restructuralism) and EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From DYM-SPT: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From RE-ST: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental). From PER-PHY-U-FUND: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: LG-DY (logical dynamics). From EXB-H-OR: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and SF-RZ (self-realization). From CULT-INFO-DY: C-ACT (composite activism).
